interface.longDescription: Use this skill whenever the user shares an image (local path, URL, or attachment) and needs it analyzed, described, or recognized. Also trigger when user asks to 'look at this image', 'what's in this picture', 'describe this screenshot', or any image-related question. This skill bridges models without native vision by calling a vision-capable model API.
